# Conditional DTO fixtures

These offline fixtures are minimal, documentation-derived examples for the
conditional DTO contract. They are not live API captures and contain no API
keys or other secrets. Each fixture preserves its original bytes; the
corresponding test asserts a SHA-256 receipt hash after SDK decoding.

- `lc1-topics-list.json`: trending topic list
- `lc2-topic-summary.json`: topic summary
- `lc3-coin-snapshot.json`: coin snapshot
- `lc4-topic-time-series.json`: topic time series
